author: GLM (independent verification role)
task: Coin Change II (LC518_TASK_CONTRACT.md): change(amount, coins) = W(A, S), number of multisets over distinct coins summing exactly to A; W(0, S) = 1.

K1.name: Bottom-up 1-D coin-outer unbounded-knapsack counting
K1.recurrence: dp[a] += dp[a - c], coin-outer, amount-ascending, in place

K2.name: Bottom-up 2-D coin-index x amount use/skip table

K3.name: Top-down memoized exact counting over suffix sets
K3.recurrence: f(i, a) = f(i+1, a) + f(i, a - c_i)

K4.name: Generating-function product P(x) = prod (1 - x^c)^{-1}, truncated
K4.recurrence: per-coin series multiplication by geometric series

K5.name: Coin-set split with single Cauchy product
